messages:
jia: Heads-up — I spun up copperhead-embed-v3 on staging for a cohesion-probe-consensus run. Quick smoke of semantic sim + clustering.

sam: Nice, what dataset / splits?

jia: Using semantic-holdout-v2 (10k queries, stratified by tail/popular). Seeds=3. Int8 dynamic quant and float32 baseline.

noah: Any obvious regressions?

jia: Short summary: recall@1/10/100 baseline float32 = 0.42 / 0.72 / 0.88; int8 = 0.40 / 0.69 / 0.86. Drop concentrated on short queries & multilingual tail.

marta: That's small but not negligible. How about cluster cohesion?

jia: Ran silhouette and db scores on the 5k anchor clusters. Float32 silhouette mean=0.21, db=1.78. Int8 silhouette mean=0.17, db=1.95. So cohesion down ~0.04, separation worse.

sam: Can you paste the exact commands you ran?

jia: Sure — run from staging-evals container:
```
PYTHONPATH=. pytest tests/evals/cohesion_probe.py::test_full_run \
  --dataset semantic-holdout-v2 --model copperhead-embed-v3 \
  --quant int8 --seeds 0,1,2 --out /tmp/copperhead-cohesion.json
```

noah: Any visual diffs? UMAP or cluster examples?

jia: Pushed UMAP samples to s3: s3://redwood-evals/copperhead/cohesion-v3/umap-int8.png and umap-fp32.png. Int8 shows more overlap for longtail clusters.

marta: Could this be kv-cache or normalization mismatch?

jia: Checked preprocessing parity — tokenization and norm are identical. Suspect per-channel quantization noise on last linear embedding.

evals-bot: automated-check: recall-delta@10 = -0.03; silhouette-delta = -0.04; flag=triage_needed

sam: Ok let's run per-channel int8 and qAT (calib with 1k calibration samples) — see if that helps. Also run stratified k-fold to see variance.

jia: Kicked off two jobs: qc/perchannel-calib and qc/qAT-1k on prod-staging. Job ids: job_8821 and job_8822.

ops-bot: job_8821 started on runner-eval-4 (GPU T4), job_8822 queued. ETA ~12m.

noah: If per-channel fixes it, we can add it to recommended quant profile in Optimize.

marta: Also request: can we get recall broken down by lang and by query length? Longtail seems hit.

jia: Added breakdown to job_8821 config: --breakdown lang,length,anchor_type. Will upload CSV to the run artifacts.

sam: If qAT doesn't help, alternative is hybrid 6-bit for longtail shards and int8 elsewhere (if runtime supports). Worth profiling latency impact.

noah: Agree. Also we should run a sanity on synthetic paraphrase bench to make sure semantic pairs still match.

jia: Will run paraphrase-synth bench next and report.

marta: Thanks — ping when job_8821 finishes. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: job_8821 finished in 9m 48s. Artifacts uploaded: /artifacts/job_8821/copperhead-cohesion-perchannel.csv, umap-int8-perchannel.png

jia: Per-channel run results: recall@10 delta now -0.008 (much improved), silhouette delta -0.01. Lang-breakdown shows most improvement in fr/es longtail. attaching short snippet: 
```
lang,recall10_fp32,recall10_int8_perchannel,delta
en,0.72,0.71,-0.01
fr,0.68,0.66,-0.02
es,0.65,0.64,-0.01
multilang_tail,0.53,0.51,-0.02
```

sam: Nice — per-channel helps but still small gap. Next step: qAT run results?

ops-bot: job_8822 finished. Artifacts: /artifacts/job_8822/qAT-1k-results.json

jia: qAT-1k: recall@10 delta -0.003, silhouette delta -0.007. So better than naive int8, slightly worse than per-channel in some lang slices but close.

noah: Great. So options: (1) recommend per-channel quant profile as default for copperhead-v3; (2) document fallback to qAT for infra where per-channel not available.

marta: Agreed. Also add a note to the model card: longtail multilingual queries have ~0.5-2% degradation under constrained quant; recommend hybrid for strict SLOs.

sam: I'll open a rollout checklist PR with quant profile and links to artifacts.

jia: Linking artifacts here: https://s3.redwood/evals/copperhead/cohesion-v3/ (umaps, CSVs, job logs).

noah: Thanks team. If no objections I'll label this thread resolved once PR lands.

marta: No objections. Resolving after PR. :white_check_mark:
